item.title: Rallying Cry – November 14, 2026
item.description: A heroic rival paramedic rushed to help an injured cat mid-AFLW final, all 129 passengers were miraculously rescued after a tanker collided with a cruise ship in New Orleans, and Hungary is bringing Rubik’s Cube production back home after more than 50 years.
